encoding: Per-file minimum of raw, zlib9, XZ6 and gzip9; fixed reversible eight-byte shuffle permitted. Strong gzip baseline chooses shuffled/unshuffled gzip9. Common compressed metadata and one mode byte per encoded payload are fully counted.
stronger_controls: Report every gzip-exact result, same-codec local/snapshot result, and manual exact-optimum tie. No minimum gain over gzip or an oracle is assumed. Adapters receive the adaptive optimum optional-byte budget; expected blocks remain visible.
scope: Finite authored catalogue fixed before full execution; not a population estimate. This is a storage-format and encoding-aware selection experiment using established lossless codecs and optimization methods. No new general compression algorithm or universal dominance is claimed. Recovery times are single descriptive measurements, not a timing comparison.
